note: Classical pi-flux only has the center Z_2 -> Hopf maps to a single point (trivial S^2, winding=0).  The quantized SU(2)_k is COMPLETE (non-central) -> covers S^2 -> non-trivial S^2 order parameter -> non-trivial Hopf.  So the source of non-trivial Hopf charge is the QUANTIZED complete SU(2)_k.
